Flappy Bird Clone

Flappy Bird Clone — flap through the pipes on canvas, chase your best score.

Click / tap / Space to flap.

📖 How to use

  1. Press “Start” (or tap the game) to begin.
  2. Click, tap or press Space to flap upward.
  3. Thread the bird through each pipe gap.
  4. Each pipe cleared scores 1 — don't hit pipes or the ground.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I control the bird?

Click, tap, or press Space to flap. Each flap gives the bird an upward kick; gravity pulls it back down between flaps.

Is my high score saved?

Your best score is saved in your browser (localStorage) and shown next to the live score.

Does it get harder?

The gap stays the same, but the pipes move faster as your score climbs.
